name: Corn Mill (Blue)
summary: A plate-type corn mill that grinds maize and other grains between two grinding plates, for corn-mill kiosks and village milling services.
description: A plate-type corn mill that grinds maize and other grains between two grinding plates, for corn-mill kiosks and village milling services. Grain goes into the top funnel and is fed by a screw into the grinding chamber, where a turning plate grinds it against a fixed plate. The hand wheel at the front sets the gap between the plates, so the same mill makes coarse grits, fine flour or smooth wet dough from soaked maize. A flywheel pulley at the back takes a belt from an electric motor or a diesel engine.
features: Feed funnel with screw feed into the grinding chamber
Replaceable grinding plates
Front hand wheel to adjust fineness
Flywheel pulley for belt drive from a motor or diesel engine
Grinds dry grain, and soaked maize for dough
Heavy steel stand with bolted feet

specs.label: Power
specs.value: Typically 7.5–15 kW motor or 10–20 hp diesel engine

specs.label: Typical capacity
specs.value: Approx. 100–300 kg/h, depending on grain and fineness

typicalUses: Community corn-mill services and kiosks; grinding dry maize into flour or grits; wet-milling soaked maize for kenkey, banku and koko dough; millet and sorghum flour.

name: Corn Mill (Green)
summary: A heavy cast plate-type corn mill with a large funnel, for busy corn-mill kiosks grinding dry maize into flour and soaked maize into dough.
description: A heavy cast plate-type corn mill with a large funnel, for busy corn-mill kiosks grinding dry maize into flour and soaked maize into dough. Grain is fed from the funnel into the grinding head, where a turning plate grinds it against a fixed plate. A screw adjuster on the grinding head sets the gap between the plates, from coarse grits to fine flour. A large flywheel pulley takes a belt from an electric motor or a diesel engine, and the solid cast frame keeps the mill steady through long working days.

Replaceable grinding plates
Screw adjuster to set fineness
Large flywheel pulley for belt drive from a motor or diesel engine

Heavy cast frame for steady running
